settings.announcement: Free delivery within Karachi · Made to order · Every piece registered with a unique article number
settings.about_story:
SULTANÉ was born from a love of regal jewellery traditions — the fluid sculpture of Italy, the intricate motifs of Türkiye and the bold silhouettes of the Middle East — reimagined in silver for today.

Every piece is made to order by our jewellery maker once your payment is verified. We would rather take the time to make your piece properly than promise a dispatch date we cannot keep.

Each purchased piece receives its own article number, recorded in our registry and printed on a SULTANÉ authenticity card, so the story of your jewellery stays with it.

faqs.a: Add standard designs to your bag and check out as a guest or with an account. You will receive an order number and bank-transfer instructions straight away.
faqs.q: How do I place an order?

faqs.a: At launch we accept bank transfer only. After placing your order, transfer the total shown and upload your receipt on the order page, or send it to us on WhatsApp. Production begins only after our team manually verifies the payment.
Every SULTANÉ piece is made to order. Each product page shows its estimated production time. Courier transit time is separate and follows dispatch.
Delivery within Karachi is free. A delivery charge applies elsewhere in Pakistan and is shown at checkout before you submit your order.

Yes. Use "Customise This Design — Request Price" on any product page, or submit an inspiration image through Customised Jewellery. We will confirm feasibility and price on WhatsApp — nothing is charged until you approve a quotation.

Eligible Premium Collection pieces offer optional gemstone testing for Rs. 799 per piece. It is selected by default and you can untick it. Documentation depends on the testing service used and is confirmed before dispatch.

Once your payment is verified, every piece you purchased receives its own unique article number. It appears on your order page, is shared on WhatsApp and is printed on your SULTANÉ authenticity card with a QR code.

Visit Verify Your Piece and enter the article number, or scan the QR code on your authenticity card. A registered number shows the owner’s name, the piece name and the purchase date — never contact or address details.
faqs.q: How do I verify my piece?

faqs.a: Store each piece separately in its pouch, keep it dry, avoid perfume and harsh chemicals, and polish gently with the SULTANÉ cloth included in your packaging.
faqs.q: How should I care for silver jewellery?

faqs.a: Message us on WhatsApp within 24 hours of receiving your order with your order number, photos or video and a description of the problem. See our Returns & Defects policy for details.
faqs.q: What if my order arrives damaged or incorrect?

settings.policy_delivery:
Free delivery within Karachi.

Delivery charges apply to orders shipped elsewhere in Pakistan. The applicable charge is calculated from your delivery city and shown at checkout before you submit your order.

Every piece is made to order. The production time shown on each product page is separate from courier transit time. We will share the courier name and tracking number on WhatsApp and on your order page once your order is dispatched.
settings.policy_returns:
Because every SULTANÉ piece is made to order, we do not accept change-of-mind returns or exchanges.

Defective or incorrect items
If your order arrives defective or is not the item you ordered, message us on WhatsApp within 24 hours of receiving it with:
• your order number
• clear photographs or a video of the item
• a short description of the problem

We will review every report and arrange a suitable remedy. This policy does not limit any rights or remedies you have under applicable consumer-protection law.
settings.policy_privacy:
We collect only the information needed to make and deliver your order: your name, phone number, delivery address and, optionally, an email address. Payment receipts you upload are visible only to the SULTANÉ team and are used solely to verify your payment.

Your article-number verification page shows only your name, the jewellery piece name and the purchase date. Your phone number and address are never shown publicly.

We do not sell your data. We contact you on WhatsApp about your orders and enquiries. To ask for your data to be corrected or deleted, contact us on WhatsApp.
settings.policy_terms:
Prices are in Pakistani Rupees (PKR). An order is confirmed once your bank-transfer payment has been manually verified by our team; production begins only after verification.

Customisation requests are not orders. A customised piece is only made after you approve a quotation shared on WhatsApp and pay the approved amount.

Material and gemstone details are stated per product. "925 Sterling Silver" appears only on pieces whose material has been confirmed.
